title: Bear cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#5a3a1a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- back paw -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='90' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#c98f4e'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#a86b32'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#d9a866'/>
  <!-- front leg raised -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='80' rx='7' ry='11' transform='rotate(-25 34 80)' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='87' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#c98f4e'/>
  <!-- arm up high -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='55' rx='6' ry='12' transform='rotate(35 28 55)' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='46' r='5' fill='#c98f4e'/>
  <!-- other arm out to side -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='62' rx='6' ry='12' transform='rotate(-50 73 62)' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='55' r='5' fill='#c98f4e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='20' fill='#a86b32'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='17' r='7' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='17' r='3.5' fill='#e0a878'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='17' r='7' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='17' r='3.5' fill='#e0a878'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#e0b47c'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#4a2a10'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 42 Q50 47 55 42' stroke='#4a2a10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='3' fill='#2a1808'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='3' fill='#2a1808'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='29' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='37' r='3' fill='#e46a6a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='37' r='3' fill='#e46a6a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <path d='M78 30 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M18 68 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
